Springfield Fall 2026 swim lessons open Tuesday, September 15 at 7:00 a.m. for residents, and the general public gets in seven days later. Max's age fits the published band. Mia's birthday is just outside it, so check that she fits before you sign up. Here is the registration page: https://rec.example.org/springfield/fall-2026

If you approve, I'll text you a week ahead, a checklist three days before, a reminder the evening before, and one 15 minutes before it opens. I never register for anyone, so you'd still do the signing up yourself. Once you've picked a course, send me its link and the morning text will include it.
